node.statement: For a,b in {1,...,r}, let c_ab:M_r->M_r be c_ab(X)=E_aa X E_bb and define the bounded operator T_ab:A->A by T_ab=v c_ab v^{-1} Co_P. Because Co_P is an idempotent with range S_P=range(v), Co_P v=v and v^{-1}Co_P v=id. Since c_ab^2=c_ab and range(c_ab)=C E_ab, T_ab is an exact bounded linear idempotent of rank one, with range C v(E_ab).
